title: No three algebraic conjugates of degree sixteen sum to zero
summary: Let $d$ be the smallest positive integer, not divisible by $3$, for which there exists an algebraic number over $\mathbb{Q}$ of degree $d$ whose some three algebraic conjugates sum to zero. Employing the classification of vertex-transitive graphs on 16 vertices of degree 6, we prove that $d\neq 16$. This, combined with results obtained by Dubickas, Smyth and Stong \cite{DubickasSmyth2006}, Dubickas and Jankauskas \cite{DubickasJankauskas2015} and Virbalas \cite{Virbalas2025a}, implies that $d=20$.
